subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call (throughput & latency requirements)
messages:
From: Ben Kline <ben@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps after discovery — scheduling capacity sizing call

Hey Marissa —

Thanks again for the discovery call today — super helpful. Our team is excited about Redwood Dedicated. To move forward we'd love to schedule a technical deep-dive / capacity sizing session so your infra folks can help size GPU pools against our workload. High-level requirements from our side:

- Expected steady-state: ~150–250 reqs/sec (RPS) for small completion calls (average 120 tokens)
- Daily tokens: ~120k–200k tokens/day across batched and interactive traffic
- Target latency: p95 end-to-end generation <= 150ms for 512-token prompts (we can tolerate higher for longer generations)
- Peak concurrency windows: 30–45 minutes during business hours for customer-facing features

Can we book a 60-min sizing call that includes an SRE/infra lead and whoever owns deployment decisions on your side? I'm attaching our quick estimate sheet so you can see our assumptions.

Proposed slots next week (PST):
- Wed May 12, 10:00–11:00
- Thu May 13, 14:00–15:00
- Fri May 14, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, happy to match your availability.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Kline
Head of Platform, Nimbus AI
ben@nimbus.ai
Attachment: nimbus-initial-estimates.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)

Hi Ben —

Really glad the discovery call was useful. Yes — a 60-min dedicated capacity sizing call is the right next step. Camila (cc'd) from our SRE/solutions team should join — she'll lead the sizing and prep a short checklist so the call is productive.

I'm sharing our capacity sizing template and a suggested agenda so we can collect the right metrics ahead of time:
- 10m: Introductions & goals
- 15m: Your traffic profile (RPS, token distribution, burst patterns)
- 25m: Sizing walkthrough + config options (batching, caching, quantization)
- 10m: Next steps + timeline (PoC / Dedicated provisioning + procurement)

I can do Thu May 13, 14:00–15:00 PST — that matches your slot. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-call questionnaire so we can come prepared.

Attachments: redwood-capacity_sizing_template.xlsx, redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf
